Screen environment UA/DPR is sourced from earlier8880same-IAB observer with actual SHA binding; no new8887 UA/DPR measurement or font/hardware certification.
Public DOM/actualSVG exactness is distinct from actual screenshot pixels; delegated pixel review cannot certify calibrated physical-size readability or aesthetics.
All39 frozen cases,36baseline+3edited, are covered in fields; screenshot pixels audited in separate part1/part2 reports.

Only publicDOM JSON metadata.heightMm versus actualSVG metadata.heightMm has a1e-9 tolerance; four float differences are recorded explicitly. Interactive XML geometry/metadata and all other fields are exact.
